findings.title: Pipe closure bypasses supervision and exception cleanup
findings.reproduction: Static trigger, not executed: an owned test process closes stdout and stderr, then continues running longer than three seconds. Both selector registrations disappear, so the monitoring loop ends even though the process remains alive. proc.wait(timeout=3) raises TimeoutExpired before the following group kill and budget persistence.
findings.evidence: The loop condition at line 33 depends only on open output pipes. The unguarded wait at line 55 precedes cleanup at lines 56 through 57 and cumulative accounting at lines 59 through 61. No try/finally encloses the launched process. RLIMIT_CPU does not bound sleeping wall time. A child in the new session created at line 26 can therefore remain alive while its elapsed time is absent from the shared 180-second ledger. The three approved checks passed normally and did not exercise this exceptional path.
findings.requested_change: Keep supervising until process termination as well as pipe closure. Place owned group termination, bounded reaping and cumulative budget persistence in unconditional cleanup, including timeout and interruption paths. Freeze any discriminating runner reproduction before execution.

findings.title: The cumulative retained-output cap is exceeded before refusal
findings.reproduction: Static trigger, not executed: the previous role output plus current captured output approaches 16777216 bytes, then either output pipe delivers another chunk. The full chunk is retained and can cross the cap. The next loop detects the excess but continues retaining queued pipe data after killing the group.
findings.evidence: Line 45 checks the old size before reads. Lines 50 and 52 read up to 65536 bytes per ready stream and append every byte without limiting retention to the remaining cumulative allowance. Line 58 joins and writes all retained chunks. Child RLIMIT_FSIZE at line 28 does not cap pipe output or the supervisor's log write. Thus a failure is detected, but the declared 16 MiB combined captured-output ceiling is not enforced. Actual approved outputs remained below the cap, with final cumulative output 397293 bytes.
findings.requested_change: Track observed output separately from retained output, retain only the remaining cumulative allowance, kill immediately on crossing it, and discard subsequent drained bytes while preserving an explicit failure reason. Freeze any discriminating output-bound reproduction before execution.
